title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.00328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. translated_title: ContractRL：面向可审计工具调用修复的屏蔽式组相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 结构化工具调用往往在仅有少量字段违反模式或执行契约时就会失败。重新生成完整对象会扩大动作空间，并使重复修复难以审计。我们提出了ContractRL，这是一种契约约束的顺序修复协议，将验证器引导的JSON修复建模为一个有界决策过程。在每一步中，策略观察候选对象、带类型的验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变的修复历史以及剩余预算；契约派生的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行状态转移之前过滤掉格式错误或被禁止的RFC-6902操作。我们为补丁、重试和放弃决策指定了契约约束的组相对目标，同时将规范目标和语义标签保持在在线状态之外，直到轨迹冻结。在相同的验证器信息下，ContractRL仅使用34.4个生成token就达到了0.9362的语义成功率。
tldr: ContractRL提出了一种契约约束的顺序修复协议，将验证器引导的JSON修复建模为有界决策过程，通过契约派生的动作掩码过滤非法修复操作，在仅生成34.4个token的情况下实现了0.9362的语义成功率，并保证了修复过程的可审计性。
en_tdlr: ContractRL introduces a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process, using contract-derived action masks to filter invalid repair operations and achieving 0.9362 semantic success with only 34.4 generated tokens while maintaining auditability.
